Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values against the human single-protein target CHEMBL4282 (RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4282, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation =, and pchembl_value not null. Require compound_structures as an INNER JOIN. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
